name: @pmndrs/reflections-pixi
description: PixiJS v8 WebGPURenderer adapter for @pmndrs/reflections (experimental): the frame contract from a pixi-3d View3D (structural: it never imports the closed beta), the core screen-space tracer and probe set on pixi's device, and the composite as a pixi Filter. Bundled into the published package; never published on its own.
